summaryJa: 2020年11月02日0608Zに機体（呼出符号は文書で1.4a）がOK.ASから離陸し、0618Zに引き継ぎを受けた。020618Zにオンステーション、JSRは021015Z～030115Z。1015Z以降はNAVCENT支援（アラビアン・ガルフ、ホルムズ海峡、オマーン湾）で目標デッキ沿いのスキャンやパターン・オブ・ライフの確立を実施。1012Zにイラン防空からのガードコールを受信、標準応答で対応し任務への影響なし。1910Z～2210Zに開放水域でUUVスキャンを実施したがUUVは特定されず。2143Zに1件、2148Zに追加の1件、計2件の未確認航空現象（UAP）をFMVで観測。0112ZにRTB許可、03日0250Zに着陸。総飛行時間20時間42分、FMVはDOSIで解析。事前調整はNAVCENTと24時間前に行われ満足と評価。気象はヘイズでIMINT収集を阻害した旨記載あり。
summaryEn: On 02 Nov 2020 at 0608Z the aircraft (callsign redacted as 1.4a) departed OK.AS and was on station from 020618Z. The JSR was 021015Z–030115Z. From 1015Z the asset supported NAVCENT operations in the Arabian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, and Gulf of Oman conducting target-deck scans and pattern-of-life ISR. At 1012Z the aircraft received a guardcall requested by Iranian air defense and responded with the standard reply; there was no mission impact. Between 1910Z and 2210Z open-water scans for UUVs found no identifications. At 2143Z and 2148Z the crew observed two UAPs on FMV. The aircraft was cleared to RTB at 0112Z and landed at 030250Z. Total mission time was 20:42; FMV was exploited by DOSI. Precoordination with NAVCENT 24 hours prior was satisfactory. Weather haze is noted as having precluded some IMINT collection.
